## Objective

Exercise actual full operation and preservation in the three required setup journeys.

## Scope

- Focused release regressions
- New create
- First existing prepare
- Older receipt upgrade
- Failure and recovery

## Entry conditions

- Exact release is distributed and native/runtime/browser authority for isolated qualification is current.

## Exit criteria

- All three success journeys meet their applicable full baseline.
- Representative refusal/recovery cases preserve bytes and report honest incomplete states.

## Risks

- Run the smallest complete required scenarios; reuse exact current evidence without replacing a missing destination check.
- Defects return to the owning task, followed by affected rebuild/distribution and requalification.
